questions.explanation: Osmosis leads to the net movement of water molecule from low osmotic pressure to high osmotic pressure. Since the iM value of solution is higher hence it has higher osmotic pressure so the water moves towards solution leads to drop of its molarity. The solute molecules do not cross S.P.M. via osmosis.
